prior_summary: Live destination-frame Cartesian targets rigidly follow the observed drawer placement goal, anchoring cavity alignment, lowering/release, retreat and the fixture-relative handle transition.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when target_pose is reliable and the drawer is open, especially near cavity alignment, descent, release, retreat and handle approach, or when the drawer/destination is displaced. It is preferred after an off-centre valid deposit because targets do not follow the resting block.
termination_guidance: Continue until the block is stationary at drawer-floor height and detached and the TCP has retreated to the handle approach. close_drawer may take over in 900:1160 but drawer motion waits for observed settling and detachment.
limitations: Assumes target_pose is accurate and rigidly related to relevant drawer geometry. Large held-block displacement is not removed by construction. The policy does not prove attachment, recover a premature drop, guarantee cavity clearance, or guarantee shifted targets are reachable.
